title: Finite-free local replacement for cokernel relations
statement: For a ringed space X, a finite type F, coherent G, map f : F ⟶ G, open U, and map g from the rank-n finite free module to (cokernel f).over U, for every x ∈ U there exist an open neighbourhood V of x with V ≤ U, a natural number m, a map ψ from the rank-m finite free module to G.over V, and an epimorphism from kernel ψ onto the restriction of kernel g along V ≤ U. The latter restriction is (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).obj (kernel g), where hVU : V ≤ U.

proof.text: Fix x in U. Locally lift the finitely many sections defining g through the cokernel projection, intersecting the resulting neighbourhoods of x. The image of f is an epimorphic image of F and hence finite type; shrink once more so that finitely many image sections generate it. Denote the resulting neighbourhood by V ≤ U.

Combine the image generators and lifts into ψ : O_V^m → G|_V. Projection to the lift summands sends kernel ψ to the relations of the restricted original tuple. In the diagram from the split finite-free sequence to image-G-cokernel, the first vertical map is epi; the snake lemma gives an epimorphism on relation kernels. Equivalently, locally express each relation among the lifts using the image generators and subtract that expression to lift it to kernel ψ.

Kernels of sheaves of modules are computed sectionwise, so the restricted relation kernel is the overMap restriction of kernel g. Return V, its inclusion in U, x ∈ V, m, ψ and the epimorphism. The empty U case is vacuous and the construction also applies to rank zero.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_cokernel_relations_local (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : F.IsFiniteType) (hG : IsCoherent X G)
    (U : Opens X) (n : ℕ)
    (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      (cokernel f).over U) :
    ∀ x : X, x ∈ U →
      ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
        ∃ (m : ℕ)
          (ψ : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over V)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ G.over V),
          ∃ e : kernel ψ ⟶
            (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).obj (kernel g),
            Epi e
